title: Exact contact: (777 - sqrt(1081))/852
description: Proves Dirichlet nonvanishing for every positive modulus and character when Re(s) > (777 - Real.sqrt 1081) / 852, excluding only the principal pole. Eliminates the rational gap above the contact point by replacing the reserve-dependent source chain with a reserve-free (epsilon = 0) source chain up to G(1, 2, 0.15) and combining a reserve-free return endpoint outside the contact neighborhood with a local c-varying return family around c* = (75 + sqrt(1081))/852. The final theorem has no analytic or source-provider premise. Builds on OpenAI, Joseph Bebel, Hailey Collet, ArviFoxy, Sil and Jacob Sussman, including the PR93 selected sextic norm, PR97 selected-leaf energy, PR98 physical return and PR103 contact return. Inherited notices and licenses are retained. The development was AI-assisted.
